proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ X _ _ _ T μ hT hμ
  rw [← hT.hasEigenvalue_iff_mem_spectrum hμ]
  constructor
  · intro he
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := he.exists_hasEigenvector
    exact ⟨x, hx.2, Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mp hx.1⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hTx⟩
    exact Module.End.hasEigenvalue_of_hasEigenvector (x := x) ⟨Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr hTx, hx⟩
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (X : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace 𝕜 X] [CompleteSpace X] (T : X →L[𝕜] X) (μ : 𝕜), IsCompactOperator T → μ ≠ 0 → (μ ∈ spectrum 𝕜 T ↔ ∃ x : X, x ≠ 0 ∧ T x = μ • x)
